subject: PioneerPay access cutover protocol and service-account delegation
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@pioneerpay.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PioneerPay onboarding — SSO/SCIM/IPs/service accounts (kickoff)

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the intro. We're ready to start the Enterprise access controls cutover for PioneerPay. High-level asks from our side:

- SSO (SAML): canonical entity ID, ACS URL, IdP-init versus SP-init guidance.
- SCIM: attribute mapping for user.active, emails, roles and an expected delta cadence.
- IP allowlist: list of egress IPs to whitelist for our API calls (tokens / webhook callbacks).
- Service accounts: recommended pattern for long-lived creds vs ephemeral, who should own service account rotation.

We have a constrained maintenance window the weekend of Apr 17–18 and would like a minimal canary (subset of 5 internal users) before org-wide cutover. Who on your side will drive the technical implementation? Also can you share a brief mutual-action plan and any docs we should circulate to our security team?

Cheers,
Elena Torres
Head of IT Security — PioneerPay
elena@pioneerpay.com

Attachment: pioneerpay-kickoff-agenda.docx (agenda outline)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@pioneerpay.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PioneerPay onboarding — SSO/SCIM/IPs/service accounts (kickoff)

Elena — thanks for the clear list. Happy to take point on the runbook and can coordinate the canary cutover. Quick responses inline: 

- SAML: we'll provide an SP metadata bundle and two ACS endpoints (primary + fallback). We support both SP-init and IdP-init; SP-init is simpler for a staged rollout.
- SCIM: default mapping includes id, userName, name.givenName, name.familyName, active, emails[type=work], and groups. We can add a custom role attribute if you need role sync. SCIM scoping is batched delta every 5 minutes by default.
- IP allowlist: production egress ranges (US): 34.198.0.0/15, 52.24.0.0/14, plus a small NAT pool we'll confirm.
- Service accounts: recommend per-environment service account with short-lived keys rotated via our KMS integration. For initial cutover we can support a temporary long-lived key but will swap to ephemeral within 48 hours.

I attached our onboarding playbook (redwood-onboard-playbook-v1.pdf) — it's a short checklist with who/what/when. Proposed next steps:
1) Tech touch call Tues Apr 6 09:00 PT with your engineers + our infra team (Priyom).
2) Share entity metadata & SCIM test credentials ahead of call.
3) Execute a canary on Apr 17 with 5 users, roll forward Apr 18 if green.

Are those dates workable? Priyom / Marissa — looping you in for tech details and support model.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-onboard-playbook-v1.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@pioneerpay.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: RE: PioneerPay onboarding — SSO/SCIM/IPs/service accounts (technical plan)

Elena / Ben — good to meet yesterday (notes below). Tech plan summary for your engineers: 

1) SAML specifics
   - SP entityID: urn:redwood:sp:pioneerpay:prod
   - ACS: https://auth.redwood.com/saml/acs/pioneerpay
   - Cert rotation: we sign assertions with an RSA key; rotate annually.
   - Recommended: start with SP-initiated flow for canary, then enable IdP-init for org-wide.

2) SCIM test harness
   - Endpoint: https://scim.redwood.com/pioneerpay/test
   - Auth: Bearer token (we'll create a scoped token with users.write and groups.read).
   - Attributes: we will add an extension attribute roles[primaryRole] if you supply a CSV mapping. 

3) IP allowlist
   - Initial egress CIDRs: 34.198.0.0/15, 52.24.0.0/14, 13.52.0.0/16
   - Webhook callback IPs will come from our NAT pool (range to be finalized by Apr 9).

4) Service accounts & rotation
   - Create a service account per environment (staging/prod). Provide least-privilege scopes.
   - We will push a short-lived credential rotation script that calls your KMS to exchange the Redwood token every 12 hours.

5) Canary plan
   - Scope: 5 pilot users (internal PioneerPay team)
   - Metrics: login success rate, SCIM sync delta, token error rate < 0.1%
   - Rollback: revert IdP metadata and suspend SCIM sync if errors exceed threshold.

Action items from this email (owners):
- Redwood (Priyom): Create SCIM test token + sample CSV for roles (by Apr 8).
- PioneerPay (Elena / Samir): Provide SA owner contact + test users list (by Apr 9).
- Ben / Marissa: Draft mutual-action plan and changelog template (by Apr 11).

If you want, I can open a short-lived support ticket with our SRE to be on call during the canary.

--
Priyom Das
Principal Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com
